## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

---

## 🤔 Problem This Solves
What problem does this feature solve for you?

- [ ] I can't do something I need to do
- [ ] Something works but is painful / slow
- [ ] Another password manager has this and I miss it
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Privacy improvement
- [ ] Other (describe below)

**Describe the pain point:**
> Example: "I have 200+ passwords and no way to visually see which ones are old and need rotation."

---

## 🎨 Proposed Solution
How do you imagine this working? Be as specific as possible.

### UI/UX
- Where should this appear? (mobile app / desktop / browser extension / dashboard)
- What should the user see?
- Any specific workflow steps?

### Backend (if applicable)
- New endpoint?
- New database table or field?
- Any impact on the zero-knowledge model?

---

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
What workarounds or alternatives have you tried?

- [ ] Using another app for this
- [ ] Manual workaround (describe)
- [ ] Waiting and hoping 😅

---

## 🧩 Why It Fits Zero Password Manager
This project has a clear philosophy. Explain why this feature aligns with it:

- [ ] **Self-hosted**: Works in self-hosted setup, no cloud dependency
- [ ] **Zero-knowledge**: Does not require server to read decrypted data
- [ ] **Privacy-first**: No telemetry, no external calls, no tracking
- [ ] **Non-commercial**: Doesn't enable monetization or lock-in patterns

---

## 📊 Priority & Impact

### How many users would benefit?
- [ ] Just me (edge case)
- [ ] Power users / self-hosters
- [ ] Most users

### Blocking something?
- [ ] This completely blocks my workflow
- [ ] Major inconvenience
- [ ] Nice to have
